{c_important}Frozen Orbs{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} more damage per active {c_important}Summon{/c} and have a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]%{/c} chance to create a random {c_important}Conjuration{/c} when Cast.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Your {c_important}Summons{/c} have up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]%{/c} chance to launch a {c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} at a Nearby enemy.
